Ill loop legal internally and send a proposed redline back by end of week. If procurement needs a mutual action plan, happy to put one on paper.

Thanks,

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the context. Quick responses:
- 45-day invoice dispute window: acceptable with a minor carve (wel add language that undisputed portions remain payable within net-30). This protects cashflow.
- Consolidated billing clause: fine; will consolidate Exhibit B & invoicing exhibit into a single billing section and preserve audit rights.
- Encryption language: we can add the Exhibit D sentence they requested (AES-256 at-rest) — confirm with infra runbook but this is standard.
- Surge liability: propose we offer a soft cap: no more than 2x monthly committed spend without prior written agreement; overage billed at surge rates in Exhibit C. Ops (Mateo) to confirm the 2x threshold is feasible operationally.

Ill draft a redline to the MSA + a matched order form with the consolidated billing clause and the net-30/45-day dispute language and circulate for internal sign-off. Target EOD Friday (2028-06-15).

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Order form tier realignment and MSA clause consolidation — Redwood redline

Daniel / Mara —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is Redwoods consolidated redline: we accepted the Performance tier uplift effective 2028-07-01, consolidated the billing exhibits into a single billing section, and agreed to AES-256 encryption-at-rest language in Exhibit D. A couple of notes:

- Invoice disputes: were OK with a 45-day dispute window provided undisputed amounts are payable net-30 (added clause).
- Surge liability: were proposing a practical cap: Brightline will not be liable for charges exceeding 2x the monthly committed spend unless Redwood provides 72 hours notice and the parties sign a short-form addendum authorizing capacity above that threshold; any overage will be billed at the surge rate in Exhibit C. This preserves predictability for both sides.

Next steps: please review the attached PDF and (a) confirm youre good with the surge mechanics and dispute carve; (b) confirm signers and routing for DocuSign. If we have agreement by Tuesday 2028-06-20 we can lock a 2028-07-01 effective date and have capacity in place for Q3 launch.

Thanks — Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
